build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The trailing cp calls reproduce the retired tsc build executor's `assets` glob and `generatePackageJson`: environment-cli is `private`, so neither the inferred `assets` target nor `dist-manifest` attaches to do it downstream.

verify-dist-load.//: Explicit, because the shared mechanism deliberately does not attach here. The inferred `verify-dist-load` (tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js) is publish-oriented and skipped for any package.json with `private: true` (tools/nx-plugins/build/detect-target.js:55-73 names environment-cli as the example), and its executor loads a dist `main`/`module`/`exports`/`bin` entry that this raw-`tsc` build never declares. This target keeps the SAME name so `nx affected -t verify-dist-load` (CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml, pull-request.yml) still covers environment-cli, but runs a narrow checker over the emitted ESM instead: it links every emitted module's bare-specifier imports and fails on a named import from a CJS-only package (backlog 788c57a5 / b8db4e3c) — the defect `nx build`/`nx test` cannot see because vitest resolves straight to source.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (entrypoint/environment-cli/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/environment-cli.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target. dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build (workspace test targetDefaults) are relisted, plus typecheck-spec so the spec corpus is gated whenever tests run (backlog 770c0919).
